//factions: Arbitrary in number. Each declares its colour one of three ways, in
order of preference: `token` names a CSS custom property, which is what
a pack does when a designer has already tuned the palette by hand and
the theme flips it; `hue` lets the framework derive fill and wash, which
is what a new pack does before anyone has tuned anything; explicit
`fill`/`wash` hex is the escape hatch. This pack uses tokens, so the
colours are the same bytes they have always been.
The `side` values in events.json, people.json and the chapters are keys
into this table and nowhere else.

map.//: Everything engine/scenes/map.js used to know about Boston.
//minZoom: Low enough that a phone can hold an ocean. At minZoom 3 a 393 px screen
shows 64 degrees of longitude, so the establishing shot could not fit
Boston and Britain at once however it was framed — Britain sat 46 px
off the right edge at the moment the narration named it.
//detail: Natural Earth is 1:10M and this pack's chapters play at zoom 11-13.5.
Without the pack's own geometry the harbour is a blob and the Charles
does not exist — emptier than the tiles this replaced, which would be
no trade. Built by tools/fetch-detail.py from this bbox.
//extent: Where this subject's coordinates are allowed to be — not where the
camera starts. The war is fought on the seaboard but decided partly in
Paris and off Flamborough Head, so the box has to hold both.
tools/check-data.py uses it to catch a swapped lat/lon, which is what a
coordinate in the wrong hemisphere almost always is.

//checks: Where the pixel checks should point their camera.
